title: CoralNPU RTL Bug Fix
description: Debug and fix bugs in the CoralNPU RISC-V vector processor RTL. The buggy design fails certain vector instruction sequences. Miners must identify and fix the issues to achieve the target functionality score.

scoring_details.functionality_description: Functionality score must be at least 70% to pass. The unmodified reference design scores ~31%.
